history.title: Our Story
history.description: At Capitán Grill we transform premium cuts into unforgettable experiences. Field grill, tradition and flavor in every bite. Every cut is chosen on the spot, hand-selected, and cooked right over the coals, exactly how you like it.

steps.title: Choose Your Cut
steps.desc: See the raw piece, feel it, and pick the exact gram you want to eat.

steps.title: To the Grill or to Go
steps.desc: We cook it right on the coals, or you take it home ready for your own grill.

steps.title: Enjoy the Experience
steps.desc: Every bite is unique. Pair your cut with the drink of your choice.

items.title: Charcoal Grilled Cuts
items.desc: Each piece hits the grill the moment you order. No rush, cooked exactly to your preferred doneness.

items.title: Perfect Pairing
items.desc: Pair your cut with craft beer, red wine, or a house cocktail. Ask our team for today's recommendation.

items.title: Outdoor Terrace
items.desc: Enjoy our terrace with an open view, perfect for a dinner under the stars or a meal with friends.

items.title: Drink Bar
items.desc: A comfortable, relaxed space where you can wait for your cut with a glass of wine or your favorite beer.

experience.title:
You don't read a menu.
You choose your cut.

cards.title: The Board Comes to You
cards.description: We don't hand you a menu. We bring the cuts to your table. See the marbling, feel the weight, and choose the exact piece and gram you want to eat.
cards.detail: From the ranch to your eyes — no middlemen.

cards.title: To the Fire. Right Now.
cards.description: What you choose goes straight to the coals. No frozen pieces, no unnecessary waiting. The fire works when you decide, cooked to exactly the doneness you ask for.

cards.title: The Boutique
cards.description: Hosting a backyard cookout? We bring the same standard to your grill. Choose your cuts, we vacuum-seal them, and they're ready to be the star of your own carne asada.
cards.detail: Capitán Grill quality, on your own grill.
